Author: ventechxiv
Name: Hair Shuffle
Punchline: Random hair colors throughout the day, powered by Glamourer.
Description:
Changes your character's hair color to a random color at an interval you choose. Requires Glamourer.

Commands:
/hairshuffle - open settings
/hairshuffle now - change hair color now
/hairshuffle on|off - turn the timer on or off
